Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Direct -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban -> Theekshy -> Thanishtika) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab.
